title: Outreach: Is This Alive Station for AbGradCon 2018
author: Nadia Szeinbaum
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ra2d2ge

steps.title: Prepare Image Materials
steps.instruction: Print and cut the images used for the 'Is it Alive' station.

substeps.instruction: Compile all images into one large poster-sized file to reduce costs.
Print the file on glossy paper at a printing facility.

steps.title: Mount Images on Foam Board
steps.instruction: Attach the images to black foam board for stability.

substeps.instruction: Cut two pieces of black foam board per image.
Glue one image onto each piece of foam board.

steps.title: Assemble Interactive Boards
steps.instruction: Create a mechanism to hide and reveal the description of each image.

substeps.instruction: Position the board with the main image on top and the board with the description behind it.
Connect the two boards using rings (via cut holes), string, or other durable materials that allow the pieces to be opened and closed repeatedly.

steps.title: Set Up Display Station
steps.instruction: Arrange the boards on a table for public interaction.

substeps.instruction: Place the foam boards standing up on a table.
Optional: Provide volunteers to interact with the public or implement a challenge with prizes (e.g., candy) for completing a questionnaire.
